items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: And when I first played across from Isham Jones, Jack Janney was playing trombone with Isham.

ctx.x: the white trombone players. We just touched on Jack Teagarden. We haven't mentioned -- just to digress -- we haven't mentioned Tommy, --
We haven't mentioned Tommy, we haven't mentioned Jack Janney. [handwritten correction: 'Janney' struck through, 'Jenney' written above]
